title: Hearing Day Assignment on the Unemployment Insurance Appeals Video Calendar
content:
**Unemployment Insurance Appeals — video session days by docket.** Video sessions sit on fixed days for some dockets. Once the date for a video session has been found, the calendar-day rule moves it to a day on which that docket's video sessions sit.

**Rule.** On the Separation Issue and the Able and Available Issue dockets a video session date moves to the first Tuesday or Thursday on or after the date found; on the Overpayment and Fraud docket it moves to the first Wednesday on or after that date; and on any other docket a video session date that falls on a Saturday or a Sunday moves to the following Monday.

## Days added, by weekday of the date found

| Weekday of the date found | Lower Authority Appeal — Separation Issue; Lower Authority Appeal — Able and Available Issue | Lower Authority Appeal — Overpayment and Fraud | Any other docket |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | 1 (to Tuesday) | 2 (to Wednesday) | 0 |
| Tuesday | 0 | 1 (to Wednesday) | 0 |
| Wednesday | 1 (to Thursday) | 0 | 0 |
| Thursday | 0 | 6 (to the next Wednesday) | 0 |
| Friday | 4 (to the next Tuesday) | 5 (to the next Wednesday) | 0 |
| Saturday | 3 (to Tuesday) | 4 (to Wednesday) | 2 (to Monday) |
| Sunday | 2 (to Tuesday) | 3 (to Wednesday) | 1 (to Monday) |

"On or after" includes the date found itself: a date found on a Tuesday or Thursday stands on the Separation Issue and Able and Available Issue dockets, and one found on a Wednesday stands on the Overpayment and Fraud docket.

*Hypothetical dates found:* Friday 8 May 2026 — Separation Issue: Tuesday 12 May; Overpayment and Fraud: Wednesday 13 May; Monetary Determination: Friday 8 May stands. Saturday 9 May 2026 — Able and Available Issue: Tuesday 12 May; Employer Benefit Charge: Monday 11 May.
